diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker passed the checks related to idempotency and deduplication (C2) despite never having access to PF1. This suggests that the model is defaulting to enabling both idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate, as specified by PF1, even when PF1 is not available. This leads to the checks passing due to a default behavior rather than requiring the hidden information.

C2.why: The staging run appears ready without this finding; PF1 changes the safeguard from the draft's unspecified behavior to enabling both idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate before production.
